Function SILSX_aImporterDonnees(Byval p_NomImportation As String, pa_Donnees As Variant, p_FermerConnexion As boolean) As Boolean ' Cette fonction retourne les données d'un fichier db2 dans un tableau On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_Champs As Variant Dim a_Formats As Variant Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Initialisations SILSX_aImporterDonnees = False pa_Donnees = ""
' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(p_NomImportation, "I") Then ' Ouvrir le fichier d'importation If SILSXLC_OuvrirFichier(xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_NomFichier", ""), _ xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLWhere", ""), xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLOrderBy", ""), v_NbSel) Then If v_NbSel <> 0 Then a_Champs = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_ChampsImport") a_Formats = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Formats") Redim a_Donnees(Ubound(a_Champs), 100) As Variant
' Boucler sur tous les enregistrements Do While SILSXLC_LireEnregistrement() v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 If v_NbLus > Ubound(a_Donnees, 2) Then Redim Preserve a_Donnees(Ubound(a_Champs), Ubound(a_Donnees, 2) + 100) As Variant End If
For i = Lbound(a_Champs) To Ubound(a_Champs) If i > Ubound(a_Formats) Then a_Donnees(i, v_NbLus - 1) = SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), "", "") Else a_Donnees(i, v_NbLus - 1) = SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), a_Formats(i), "") End If Next Loop
If v_NbLus > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_Donnees(Ubound(a_Champs), v_NbLus - 1) As Variant Redim a(v_NbLus - 1, Ubound(a_Champs)) As Variant For i = 0 To Ubound(a_Champs) For j = 1 To v_NbLus a(j - 1, i) = a_Donnees(i, j - 1) Next Next pa_Donnees = a End If End If
SILSX_aImporterDonnees = True End If
If p_FermerConnexion then Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(p_NomConnexionLSX As String, p_Transfert As String) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ouvrir la connexion avec le serveur ' p_Transfert : NULL = aucun, I = Importation, E = Exportation On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_OuvrirConnexion As boolean
If p_NomConnexionLSX = g_NomConnection_SILSX Then SILSX_OuvrirConnexion = True Else SILSX_OuvrirConnexion = False v_OuvrirConnexion = False
Call SILSX_FermerConnexion
' Vérifier si la connexion est déjà ouverte If gnd_SILSX_SILSX Is Nothing Then v_OuvrirConnexion = True elseIf xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Nom", "") <> p_NomConnexionLSX Then Call SILSX_FermerConnexion v_OuvrirConnexion = True End if
' Extraire le document des parametres If v_OuvrirConnexion then Set gnd_SILSX_SILSX = xndSILSX(p_NomConnexionLSX, True) If gnd_SILSX_SILSX Is Nothing Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Erreur lors de l'ouverture de la connexion: " & p_NomConnexionLSX & " introuvable.", 1, 0, False) Exit Function End If End if
' Vérifie que la connexion est configurée pour le type de transfert demandé If p_Transfert <> "" And p_Transfert <> xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Transfert", "") Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Erreur lors de l'ouverture de la connexion: Type de transfert invalide (" & p_NomConnexionLSX & ")", 1, 0, False) Exit Function End If
' Ouvrir la connexion If SILSXLC_OuvrirConnexion(xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_TypeConnection", "db2"), _ xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_NomServeur", ""), xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Utilisateur", ""), _ xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_MotPasse", ""), xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Journalisation", "1") = "0") Then SILSX_OuvrirConnexion = True g_NomConnection_SILSX = p_NomConnexionLSX End If
g_NbEnregistrements_SILSX = 0 End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomConnexionLSX, False) Exit Function End Function

Dim v_Fichier As String Dim v_Resultat As Long
SILSX_Supprimer = False MsgBox "SILSX_Supprimer" ' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(p_NomConnexion, "") Then

Function SILSX_ExporterCollection(pndc_Donnees As NotesDocumentCollection, Byval p_NomConnexion As String, _ p_DeleteSQLWhere As String) As Boolean ' Cette fonction exporte des données Notes vers un fichier DB2 On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Fichier As String Dim v_NbEnregistrements As Long Dim a_Colonnes As Variant Dim a_Types As Variant Dim a_Longueurs As Variant Dim a_Formules As Variant Dim a_Valeurs As Variant Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
If pndc_Donnees.Count = 0 Then SILSX_ExporterCollection = True Exit Function End If
' Initialisations SILSX_ExporterCollection = False
' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(p_NomConnexion, "E") = False Then Exit Function End If
v_Fichier = xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_NomFichier", "")
' Supprimer les documents existants If p_DeleteSQLWhere <> "" Then If Not SILSXLC_SupprimerEnregistrements(v_Fichier, p_DeleteSQLWhere, v_NbEnregistrements) Then Goto FermerSession End If End If
a_Colonnes = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_ChampsExport") a_Types = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_TypesExport") a_Longueurs = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_LongueursExport") a_Formules = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_FormulesExport")
Set nd = pndc_Donnees.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing ' Préparer les valeurs à insérer Call SILSX_Export_PreparerValeurs(nd, a_Colonnes, a_Types, a_Longueurs, a_Formules, a_Valeurs)
' Ajouter l'enregistrement If Not SILSXLC_AjouterEnregistrement(v_Fichier, a_Colonnes, a_Valeurs, v_NbEnregistrements) Then Goto FermerSession End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
Set nd = pndc_Donnees.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
SILSX_ExporterCollection = True
FermerSession: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomConnexion, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ndcImporterDonnees(Byval p_NomConnexion As String, p_SQLWhere As String, pndb As NotesDatabase, _ pndc_Donnees As NotesDocumentCollection, p_NbErr As Long, p_FermerConnexion As boolean) As Boolean ' Cette fonction retourne les données d'un fichier db2 dans une collection ' NbErr = Nb documents qui ont échoué le ComputeWithForm On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_SQLWhere As String Dim ni_Operations As Notesitem Dim a_Champs As Variant Dim a_Formats As Variant Dim a_Items As Variant Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim a_CleLSX As Variant Dim v_Valeur As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer Dim v As Variant Dim v_ValeurErreur As String Dim v_Format As String
' Initialisations Set pndc_Donnees = nothing v_ValeurErreur = p_NomConnexion Set nv = pndb.GetView("V_AdmT") Call nv.Refresh Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey("** BiDoN **", True) Set pndc_Donnees = ndc
' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(p_NomConnexion, "I") Then If xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_ImporterCollection", "") <> "1" Then Exit Function End If
' Ouvrir le fichier d'importation v_SQLWhere = xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLWhere", "") If p_SQLWhere <> "" Then If v_SQLWhere = "" Then v_SQLWhere = p_SQLWhere Else v_SQLWhere = "(" & v_SQLWhere & ") and (" & p_SQLWhere & ")" End If End If ' Print "v_SQLWhere : " & v_SQLWhere '************************************************************ If SILSXLC_OuvrirFichier(xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_NomFichier", ""), _ v_SQLWhere, xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLOrderBy", ""), v_NbSel) Then ' Print "v_NbSel : " & CStr(v_NbSel) '************************************************************ If v_NbSel <> 0 Then ' Initialisations SILSX Set ni_Operations = gnd_SILSX_SILSX.Getfirstitem("SILSX_Operations") a_Champs = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_ChampsImport") a_Formats = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Formats") a_Items = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Items") Set nv = pndb.Getview(xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_NomVue", "")) If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les enregistrements Do While SILSXLC_LireEnregistrement() v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_Maj = False
a_CleLSX = xVarArray(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_Cle") Redim a_Cle(Ubound(a_CleLSX)) As Variant For i = 0 To Ubound(a_CleLSX) a_Cle(i) = SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(a_CleLSX(i)), a_Formats(a_CleLSX(i)), "") Next ' Print CStr(v_NbLus) & ".Cle : " & Implode(a_Cle, ";") '************************************************************ Set nd = nv.Getdocumentbykey(a_Cle, True) ' Nouveau document ' --------------------------- If nd Is Nothing Then If ni_Operations.Contains("A") Then Set nd = New NotesDocument(pndb) nd.Form = xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_NomMasque", "")
nd.HistoDI = Now nd.HistoUI = ns.Username nd.HistoTI = "A"
v_Maj = True End If
' Document existant ' -------------------------- Elseif ni_Operations.Contains("M") Then nd.HistoDI = Now nd.HistoUI = ns.Username nd.HistoTI = "M"
v_Maj = True End If
' Mise à jour des items ' ------------------------------ If v_Maj Then v_Maj = nd.IsNewNote
For i = Lbound(a_Champs) To Ubound(a_Champs) v_ValeurErreur = a_Champs(i) If i > Ubound(a_Formats) Then v_Valeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), "", v_Format) Else v_Valeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), a_Formats(i), v_Format) End If
If Cstr(v_Valeur) <> xVarImplode(nd, a_Items(i), ";") Then If v_Format = "D" Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd, a_Items(i), v_Valeur) elseIf v_Format = "H" Then Call SIIx_AssignerHeure(nd, a_Items(i), v_Valeur) else Call nd.ReplaceItemValue(a_Items(i), v_Valeur) End if v_Maj = True End If Next
If v_Maj Then ' Appliquer les formules If nd.IsNewNote Then v = xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_FormuleAjout", "") Else v = xVar(gnd_SILSX_SILSX, "SILSX_FormuleModification", "") End If If v <> "" Then v = Evaluate(v, nd) End If
' Compute with form if nd.Computewithform(True, False) = False Then p_NbErr = p_NbErr + 1 End If
' Sauvegarder le nouveau document Call nd.Save(True, False)
Call ndc.AddDocument(nd) End If End If Loop End If End If
If p_FermerConnexion then Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() End if End If
Set pndc_Donnees = ndc SILSX_ndcImporterDonnees = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, Getthreadinfo(1), v_ValeurErreur, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_Export_PreparerValeurs(pnd As NotesDocument, pa_Colonnes As Variant, pa_Types As Variant, pa_Longueurs As Variant, pa_Formules As Variant, pa_Valeurs As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v As Variant
SILSX_Export_PreparerValeurs = False
' Préparer les valeurs à insérer Redim a_Valeurs(Ubound(pa_Colonnes)) As Variant For i = Lbound(pa_Colonnes) To Ubound(pa_Colonnes) If pa_Formules(i) = "#" Then g_NbEnregistrements_SILSX = g_NbEnregistrements_SILSX + 1 v = Evaluate(cstr(g_NbEnregistrements_SILSX)) else v = Evaluate(pa_Formules(i), pnd) End If Select Case pa_Types(i) Case "N": ' Numérique If v(0) = "" Then a_Valeurs(i) = "0" Else a_Valeurs(i) = Replace(Cstr(v(0)),",",".") End If Case "D": ' Date If v(0) = "" Then a_Valeurs(i) = "0" Elseif Datatype(v(0)) = 7 Then If Cint(pa_Longueurs(i)) = 6 Then a_Valeurs(i) = Format(v(0), "yymmdd") Else a_Valeurs(i) = Format(v(0), "yyyymmdd") End If Else a_Valeurs(i) = "0" End If Case "T": ' Heure If v(0) = "" Then a_Valeurs(i) = "0" ElseIf DataType(v(0)) = 7 Then If CInt(pa_Longueurs(i)) = 4 Then a_Valeurs(i) = Format(v(0), "hhnn") Else a_Valeurs(i) = Format(v(0), "hhnnss") End If Else a_Valeurs(i) = "0" End If Case Else: 'S If v(0) = "" Then a_Valeurs(i) = "' '" Else a_Valeurs(i) = "'" & Implode(Split(Left(Cstr(v(0)), pa_Longueurs(i)),"'"),"''") & "'" End If End Select Next
pa_Valeurs = a_Valeurs SILSX_Export_PreparerValeurs = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ExecuterSQL(p_NomImportation As String, p_SQL As String, p_FermerConnexion As Boolean) As Long ' Vakleur retournée : Le nb d'enregistrements traités. Retourne -1 si une erreur s'est produite On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NbEnregistrements As Long
SILSX_ExecuterSQL = -1
' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(p_NomImportation, "") Then
' Exécuter la commande SQL If SILSXLC_ExecuterSQL(p_SQL, v_NbEnregistrements) Then SILSX_ExecuterSQL = v_NbEnregistrements End If
If p_FermerConnexion Then Call SILSX_FermerConnexion End If End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomImportation & " : " & p_SQL, False) Exit Function End Function

Function xSIRq_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSIRq_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSIRq_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSIRq_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSIRq_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSIRq_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSIRq_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSIRq_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.

Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSIRq_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSIRq_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xTypMLProd(Byval p_Cle As Variant,Byval p_VersionSDS As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Cette fonction permet d'extraire le type de média à utiliser pour le programme en question. 'Parametres: p_Cle ---> Nom du programme (logiciel) de SDS Base (LPDBMM) ' p_VersionSDS ----> La version SDS utilisée chez le client (Provient de CSA) 'Retourne le type de média qui correspond à la version SDS pour cette distribution 'pour ce programme '-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim nd_Logiciel As NotesDocument Dim a_LProdVersion As Variant Dim a_LProdTypeMedia As Variant Dim i As Integer
'Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations xSDSBB_xTypMLProd = "Internet"
'Extraire la liste des versions et les médias qui y correspondent Set nd_Logiciel = xSDSBB_xndProd_Code(p_Cle, True) a_LProdVersion = xVarArray(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_MediaVersions") a_LProdTypeMedia = xVarArray(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_MediaTypes")
If Isarray(a_LProdVersion) And Isarray(a_LProdTypeMedia) Then If Ubound(a_LProdVersion) <> Ubound(a_LProdTypeMedia) Then Exit Function End If
'Boucler jusqu'à ce qu'on ait trouvé l'emplacement de la version de SDS de notre client For i = Ubound(a_LProdVersion) To 0 Step -1 If p_VersionSDS >= a_LProdVersion(i) Then 'Retourner le type de média qui correspond à la version SDS xSDSBB_xTypMLProd = a_LProdTypeMedia(i) Exit Function End If Next End If End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_NAB" Use "x_SIEm"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gnuiws_SICJ As NotesUIWorkspace
Dim gns_SICJ As Notessession Dim gndb_SICJ As Notesdatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SICJ = "SL" Const gc_Element_SICJ = "SI_Jabber"

Function SICJ_DemarrerJabber(p_NoEmploye As String, p_Action As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de communiquer en utilisant Jabber. ' Actions : T = Téléphoner, C = Clavarder (chat) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim s As String
SICJ_DemarrerJabber = False
If p_NoEmploye = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Téléphoner ' ------------- If p_Action = "T" Then s = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoEmploye, "Empl_PosteTelephonique", "", True) If SICJ_Telephoner(s) Then SICJ_DemarrerJabber = True End If
Exit Function End If
' Clavarder ' ------------- s = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoEmploye, "Empl_NotesId", "", True) If s = "" Then Exit Function End If
s = xNAB_xVarPerson(s, "InternetAddress", "", True) If s = "" Then Exit Function End If
Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", "xmpp:" & Lcase(s), Null, "", SW_SHOW) SICJ_DemarrerJabber = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICJ, gc_Element_SICJ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICJ_Telephoner(Byval p_NoTelephone As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de communiquer en utilisant Jabber. ' Actions : T = Téléphoner, C = Clavarder (chat) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
SICJ_Telephoner = False
If p_NoTelephone = "" Then Exit Function End If
p_NoTelephone = Lcase(Replace(p_NoTelephone, Evaluate(|" " : "-" : "(" : ")"|), "")) If Instr(p_NoTelephone, "x") > 0 Then p_NoTelephone = Strleft(p_NoTelephone, "x") End If
' If Len(p_NoTelephone) >= 7 Then ' p_NoTelephone = "9" & p_NoTelephone ' End If Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", "ciscotel:" & p_NoTelephone, Null, "", SW_SHOW) SICJ_Telephoner = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICJ, gc_Element_SICJ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICJ_Initialisations As Boolean SICJ_Initialisations = False
If gns_SICJ Is Nothing Then Set gns_SICJ = New Notessession Set gndb_SICJ = gns_SICJ.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_SICJ = New NotesUIWorkspace
SICJ_Initialisations = True End If
SICJ_Initialisations = True End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSCS" ou "SDSCS" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSCS" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "CSCo" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSCS As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSCS As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSDSCS As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSDSCS As Notesdocument Dim gnv_CSCo_xSDSCS As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSCo_xSDSCS As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_CSCo_Client_xSDSCS As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSCo_Client_xSDSCS As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_CSFa_xSDSCS As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSFa_xSDSCS As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_CSPr_xSDSCS As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSPr_xSDSCS As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSCS = "SDSCS" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleCSCo_xSDSCS = "CSCo_NoContratFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCSCo_xSDSCS = "V_CSCo20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleCSCo_Client_xSDSCS = "CSCo_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCSCo_Client_xSDSCS = "V_CSCo12" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleCSFa_xSDSCS = "CSFa_NoContrat" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCSFa_xSDSCS = "V_CSFa20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVueCSPr_xSDSCS = "V_CSPr30" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Sub Terminate
End Sub

Function xSDSCS_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSCS_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSDSCS, "V_Tabl20", gnvTabl_xSDSCS, gndTabl_xSDSCS) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSCS_xndTabl = gndTabl_xSDSCS End Function

Function xSDSCS_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SDSCS As NotesSession Dim gndb_SDSCS As NotesDatabase Dim gndb_Base_SDSCS As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SDSCS = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSCS = "SDS_ContratsService"

Sub SDSCS_ClientsModule_Code(p_CodeProduit As String, pa_ClientNoFmt As Variant) ' Retourne la liste des clients qui ont un module dans leur CS ' Paramètres ' p_CodeProduit I Le code du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' pa_ClientNoFmt O Un array des numéros des clients qui opnt le module dans leur CS On Error Goto GererErreur
Call SDSCS_ClientsModule(xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(p_CodeProduit, "Prod_CleProduit", "", True), pa_ClientNoFmt)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_CleProduit As String, p_PrixProduit As Double, p_NoContrat As String) As Boolean ' Retourne le prix unitaire d'un service ' Paramètres ' p_ClientNoFmt I Le numéro du client ' p_CleProduit I La clé du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' p_PrixProduit O Le prix du produit ' p_NoContrat O Le no du contrat sur lequel le produit se trouve On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nv_Prod As NotesView Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim v_Prix As Double Dim v_CodeProduit As String
SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle = False p_PrixProduit = 0
' Rechercher le produit dans le CS Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSCo_Client(p_ClientNoFmt, True)
If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then p_NoContrat = xVar(nd, "CSCO_NoContrat", "") If xVar(nd, "CSCo_TypeInstallation","")="1" Then v_CodeProduit=xSDSBB_xVarProd(p_CleProduit, "Prod_CleProduitAH", "", True) Else v_CodeProduit=xSDSBB_xVarProd(p_CleProduit, "Prod_CleProduitCS", "", True) End If
v_Prix = xSDSCS_xVarCSPr_Cle(xVar(nd, "CSCO_NoContratFmt",""), v_CodeProduit, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire", -1) If v_Prix >= 0 Then p_PrixProduit = v_Prix SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle = True Exit Function End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCS_ClientsModule(p_CleProduit As String, pa_ClientNoFmt As Variant) ' Retourne la liste des clients qui ont un module dans leur CS ' Paramètres ' p_CleProduit I La cle du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' pa_ClientNoFmt O Un array des numéros des clients qui opnt le module dans leur CS On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Prod32 As NotesView Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim nd_Prod_AH As NotesDocument Dim nd_Prod_CS As NotesDocument
Dim v_Formule As String Dim a As Variant
' Validation des paramètres pa_ClientNoFmt = "" If p_CleProduit = "" Then Exit Sub End If
' Initialisations Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
' Liste des codes de produit à vérifier (Sur site + Hébergé) Set nd_Prod = xSDSBB_xndProd(p_CleProduit, True) If nd_Prod Is Nothing Then Exit Sub End If
Set nv_Prod32 = gndb_xSDSBB.getView("V_Prod32") Call nv_Prod32.Refresh Select Case xvar(nd_Prod, "Prod_ClasseProduit", "") Case "AH" : Set nd_Prod_AH = nd_Prod Set nd_Prod = nv_Prod32.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduit", ""), True) Set nd_Prod_CS = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitCS", ""), True) Case "CS" : Set nd_Prod_CS = nd_Prod Set nd_Prod = nv_Prod32.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduit", ""), True) Set nd_Prod_AH = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitAH", ""), True) Case Else : Set nd_Prod_AH = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitAH", ""), True) Set nd_Prod_CS = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitCS", ""), True) End Select
' Liste des clients AH dans les CS If Not (nd_Prod_AH Is Nothing) Then Call xSDSCS_Initialisations v_Formule = |@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr27"; "| & xVar(nd_Prod_AH, "Prod_CleProduit", "") & |"; 3; [FailSilent])| a = Evaluate(v_Formule) If a(0) <> "" Then pa_ClientNoFmt = Evaluate(|@Unique("| & Implode(a, |":"|) & |")|) End If End If
' Liste des clients CS dans les CS If Not (nd_Prod_CS Is Nothing) Then Call xSDSCS_Initialisations v_Formule = |@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr27"; "| & xVar(nd_Prod_CS, "Prod_CleProduit", "") & |"; 3; [FailSilent])| a = Evaluate(v_Formule) If a(0) <> "" Then If Isarray(pa_ClientNoFmt) Then pa_ClientNoFmt = Evaluate(|@Unique("| & Implode(pa_ClientNoFmt, |":"|) & |":"| & Implode(a, |":"|) & |")|) Else pa_ClientNoFmt = Evaluate(|@Unique("| & Implode(a, |":"|) & |")|) End If End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCS_PrixModule_Code(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_CodeProduit As String, p_PrixProduit As Double, p_NoContrat As String) As Boolean ' Retourne le prix unitaire d'un service ' Paramètres ' p_ClientNoFmt I Le numéro du client ' p_CodeProduit I Le code du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' p_PrixProduit O Le prix du produit ' p_NoContrat O Le no du contrat sur lequel le produit se trouve On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSCS_PrixModule_Code = SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle(p_ClientNoFmt, xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(p_CodeProduit, "Prod_CleProduit", "", True), p_PrixProduit, p_NoContrat)
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCS_ExtraireContratService(p_ClientNoFmt As String, pl_ValeursContrat List As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Statut As String Dim a_ClesModules As Variant Dim a_CodesModules As Variant Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_Pos0 As Variant Dim v_Pos1 As Variant
SDSCS_ExtraireContratService = False
' -A- Initialisation de la liste des données du contrat pl_ValeursContrat("Statut") = "" ' 30=Prêt, 50=En vigueur pl_ValeursContrat("Suspendu") = "" ' 1=oui, ""=non pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "" ' 0=SDSBase, 1=SDSWIN, ""=aucun pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDS") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "" ' 0=Light, 1=Full, ""=aucun pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDSMerlin") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules") = "" ' Liste des clés des modules (array) pl_ValeursContrat("Modules") = "" ' Liste des codes des modules (array) pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = "" pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = "" ' CAD ou USD
' Extraire le contrat de service Set ndc = xSDSCS_xndcCSCo_Client(p_ClientNoFmt) If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing v_Statut = xVar(nd, "CSCo_StatutContrat", "00") If v_Statut > pl_ValeursContrat("Statut") Then pl_ValeursContrat("Statut") = v_Statut End If
If v_Statut >= "50" Then ' Liste des modules du CS v_Formule = |@UpperCase(@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr30"; "| & xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") & |"; 2; [FailSilent]))| a_ClesModules = Evaluate(v_Formule) If a_ClesModules(0) <> "" Then v_Formule = |@UpperCase(@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr30"; "| & xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") & |"; 3; [FailSilent]))| a_CodesModules = Evaluate(v_Formule)
' Cumuler les modules des CS If Isarray(pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules")) Then pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules") = Arrayunique(Arrayappend(pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules"), a_ClesModules), 1) pl_ValeursContrat("Modules") = Arrayunique(Arrayappend(pl_ValeursContrat("Modules"), a_CodesModules), 1) Else pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules") = a_ClesModules pl_ValeursContrat("Modules") = a_CodesModules End If
v_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd,"CSCo_TypeInstallation","")
' Verifier les modules pour SDSWin If pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "" then pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "0" End if If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008697") ' C-SDSWIN v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008661") ' C-SDSBASE
If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008816")) Then 'C-SDSMSERV pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "1" End If Else v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "9KLNLT") ' S-SDSWIN v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0006122") ' S-SDSBASE End If
If (Not Isnull(v_Pos1)) Or (Not Isnull(v_Pos0)) Then If Not Isnull(v_Pos1) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "1" Elseif Not Isnull(v_Pos0) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "0" End If
pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_Devise", "CAD") pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDS") = v_TypeInstallation End If
' Verifier les modules pour SDS Merlin pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "0" If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008663") ' C-SDSF&IFULL v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008665") ' C-SDSF&ILITE
If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008817")) Then 'C-SLSMSERV pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "1" End If Else v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "9KLNPW") ' S-SDSF&IFULL v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "9KLNPY") ' S-SDSF&ILITE End If
If (Not Isnull(v_Pos1)) Or (Not Isnull(v_Pos0)) Then If Not Isnull(v_Pos1) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "1" Elseif Not Isnull(v_Pos0) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "0" End If
If pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_Devise", "CAD") End If pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDSMerlin") = v_TypeInstallation End If End If
If pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "" And pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_Devise", "CAD") End If
' Vérifier si le contrat est suspendu If xVar(nd, "CSCo_SoutienActif", "") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("Suspendu") = "1" End If End If
Set nd = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd) Loop
SDSCS_ExtraireContratService = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_Conf As NotesSession Dim gndb_Conf As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A ="A_acCML"

Sub Initialize %REM p_Type String "v" = "VPN, "c" = Client Access, "j" = JWalk (SDSWin), "r" = Router , "s" = vpn console %END REM On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc_Conf As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Conf As NotesDocument Dim v_Form As String Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
Call A_Initialisations
Set ndc_Conf = gndb_Conf.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc_Conf.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Conf = ndc_Conf.GetFirstDocument v_Form = xVar(nd_Conf, "Form", "")
If v_Form = "F_Equi" Then v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Conf, "Equi_ClientNoFmt", "") Else v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Conf, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") End If
If v_ClientNoFmt <> "" Then Call SICf_ConnexionVPN(v_ClientNoFmt, "g", nd_Conf) End If End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations
If gns_Conf Is Nothing Then Set gns_Conf = New NotesSession Set gndb_Conf = gns_Conf.CurrentDatabase End If
End Sub

Dim gnuiws_SIAi As Notesuiworkspace
Dim gnv_SIAi1_SIAi As Notesview Dim gnv_SIAi2_SIAi As Notesview
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIAi = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIAi = "SI_Aide"

Function SIAi_SelectionnerAide(Byval p_Categorie As String) As String '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de sélectionner l'Aide à effectuer. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_SIAi As Variant
SIAi_SelectionnerAide = ""
' Si aucune catégorie n'est spécifiée, sélectionner une Aide parmis toutes les catégorie ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- If p_Categorie = "" Then If gnv_SIAi1_SIAi Is Nothing Then Set gnv_SIAi1_SIAi = gndb_SIAi.Getview("V_SIAi20") End If
Set nd = gnv_SIAi1_SIAi.Getfirstdocument If nd Is Nothing Then Messagebox "Il n'y a aucune aide disponible.", 16, "Aide" Exit Function End If
' Sélection de l'Aide v_SIAi = gnuiws_SIAi.Pickliststrings(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_SIAi.Server, gndb_SIAi.Filepath, "V_SIAi21", "Aide", _ "Choisissez la page d'aide que vous voulez consulter.", 2)
' Si une catégorie est spécifiée, sélectionner une Aide de la catégorie ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Else If gnv_SIAi2_SIAi Is Nothing Then Set gnv_SIAi2_SIAi = gndb_SIAi.Getview("V_SIAi21") End If
Set nd = gnv_SIAi2_SIAi.Getdocumentbykey(p_Categorie) If nd Is Nothing Then Messagebox "Il n'y a aucune aide disponible dans la catégorie " & p_Categorie & ".", 16, "Aide" Exit Function End If
' Sélection de l'Aide v_SIAi = gnuiws_SIAi.Pickliststrings(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_SIAi.Server, gndb_SIAi.Filepath, "V_SIAi21", "Aide de documents", _ "Choisissez la page d'aide que vous voulez consulter.", 3, p_Categorie) End If
If Isarray(v_SIAi) Then SIAi_SelectionnerAide = v_SIAi(Lbound(v_SIAi)) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAi, gc_Element_SIAi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAi_AfficherAide(p_SIAi As String, p_Categorie As String) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'afficher une page d'aide. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Langue As string
SIAi_AfficherAide = False Call SIAi_Initialisations
' Sélectionner l'Aide à imprimer ' ---------------------------------------------- If p_SIAi = "" Then p_SIAi = SIAi_SelectionnerAide(p_Categorie) End If
If p_SIAi <> "" Then Set nd = xndSIAi(p_SIAi, True) If nd Is Nothing Then Messagebox "Il n'y a pas d'aide disponible pour ce code (" & p_SIAi & ").", 16, "Opération annulée" Else v_Langue = xLangue If xVar(nd, "SIAi_Description" & v_Langue, "") = "" Then v_Langue = "FR" End If ' Afficher la page d'aide ' ----------------------------------- Call gnuiws_SIAi.DialogBox("DB_SIAi_" & v_Langue, True, True, True, True, True, True, xVar(nd, "SIAi_Nom", "Aide"), nd, True, True, False) End If End If
SIAi_AfficherAide = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAi, gc_Element_SIAi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIAi_AfficherAideMasque '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'afficher une page d'aide pour le masque courant. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument
Call SIAi_Initialisations
' Obtenir le document courant ' --------------------------------------------- Set nd = gnuiws_SIAi.Currentdocument.Document
If xVar(nd, "Form", "") <> "" Then Call SIAi_AfficherAide(xVar(nd, "Form", ""), "") End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAi, gc_Element_SIAi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SIAi_Initialisations If gns_SIAi Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIAi = New Notessession Set gndb_SIAi = gns_SIAi.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_SIAi = New Notesuiworkspace End If End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_NotesAPI" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Const NSF_INFO_SIZE = 128 Const INFOPARSE_DESIGN = 3 Const NOTE_ID_ICON = &HFFFF0010
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINDB = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINDB = "SI_NotesDatabase"

Function SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim dp As String Dim s% Dim rc% Dim hDB As Long Dim dbserver$ Dim dbfilepath$ Dim nri As SINAPI_DBREPLICAINFO
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = False
dbserver$ = pndb.Server dbfilepath$ = pndb.Filepath
dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
s% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB)
If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
If dbserver$ = "" Then rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dbfilepath$, hDb) Else rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dbserver$ & "!!" & dbfilepath$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
' Droits Admin requis pour executer, sinon erreur 'Set nr = pndb.ReplicationInfo 'Call nr.ClearHistory() 'Call nr.Save()
' Vider historique de réplication rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDB, nri) rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClearReplHistory( hDB ,0 ) rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDB, nri)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Impossible de vider l'historique de réplication : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClose(hDB)
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_RefreshDesign(templateserver$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim s As Integer Dim hDB As Long s% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB) If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
SINAPI_DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Sub SINDB_SetDesignTemplate(templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) SINAPI_NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ndGetDesignElement(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_TypeElement As String, p_NomElement As String) As NotesDocument ' PAS TESTÉ ************************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nnc As NotesNoteCollection Dim s As String Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nnc = pndb.CreateNoteCollection(False) Select Case p_TypeElement Case "F": nnc.SelectForms = True Case "V": nnc.SelectViews = True Case Else Call nnc.SelectAllDesignElements(True) End Select ' nnc.SelectionFormula = |@IsMember("F_Tabl"; @GetField("$Title"))| Call nnc.BuildCollection
s = nnc.Getfirstnoteid Do Until s = "" Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentById(s) Set ni = nd.Getfirstitem("$TITLE") If ni.Contains(p_NomElement) Then Set SINDB_ndGetDesignElement = nd Exit Do End If s = nnc.Getnextnoteid(s) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDB_ChangerIDReplique(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Server As String Dim FileName As String Dim Rep As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim hDb As Long Dim rc% Dim RepInfo As SINAPI_DBREPLICAINFO Dim var As Variant
SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = False server$ = pndb.Server filename$ = pndb.FilePath Do Set ndb = New NotesDatabase("", "") rep$ = Right("00000000" & Cstr(Clng(Today)), 8) & Right("00000000" & Cstr(Int((Now - Today) * 100000000)), 8) Loop Until Not ndb.OpenByReplicaID(server$, rep$)
If Server$ = "" Then rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(FileName$, hDb) Else rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(Server$ & "!!" & FileName$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: L'information de la réplique n'est pas disponible : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
RepInfo.ID.Innards(1) = Val( "&H"+Left$( rep$, 8 ) ) RepInfo.ID.Innards(0) = Val( "&H"+Right$( rep$, 8 ) )
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDb, RepInfo) ' take a deep breath... :-)
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo) If rc% <> 0 Then Print "*** Impossible de vérifier si le nouvel ID de réplique a été modifié correctement : " & pndb.Title Else Print "Le nouvel ID de réplique de la base de documents « " & pndb.Title & " » est " & Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(1)), 8) + ":" + Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(0)), 8) End If
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClose(hDb) SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_ReplaceDesign(templateserver$, templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) SINAPI_NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
Dim hNT As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, NOTE_ID_ICON, 0, hNT SINAPI_NSFItemSetText hNT, "$TITLE", d$, Instr(d$, Chr$(0)) SINAPI_NSFNoteUpdate hNT, 0 SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT
SINAPI_DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SITp_ndTemp(p_Description As String) As NotesDocument ' Fonction permettant de créer un nouveau document temporaire On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nd As NotesDocument
Set SITp_ndTemp = Nothing
Set gndb_Temp_SITp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") If gndb_Temp_SITp Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not gndb_Temp_SITp.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If
Set SITp_ndTemp = New NotesDocument(gndb_Temp_SITp) SITp_ndTemp.Cle = Evaluate(|@Unique|) SITp_ndTemp.Description = p_Description SITp_ndTemp.HistoDC = Now SITp_ndTemp.HistoUC = ns.UserName Exit Function

Dim gns_VAdmS As notesSession Dim gndb_VAdmS As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_VAdmS As NotesUIWorkspace
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VAdmS = "SL" Const gc_Element_VAdmS = "V_AdmV"

Sub VAdmS_acDeverrouiller '=============================================================== ' Déverrouiller les documents sélectionnés '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ws_AdmV As New cl_AdmV Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim i As integer Dim v_NbMaj As long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 223, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
' Initialiser le web service Set ws_AdmV = New cl_AdmV
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
i = ws_AdmV.DeverrouillerDocument(gndb_VAdmS.Server, gndb_VAdmS.FilePath, nd.Universalid) If i >= 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 224, "", "") & " (" & cstr(i) & ")", 48, "Déverouillage" End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView.Deselectall Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 225, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Set gnuiws_VAdmS = New notesuiworkspace End If End Sub

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire se trouvent dans la base de documents courante. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être x_SIAi où SIAi est le type de document. ' 2. Inscrire le nom de l'item qui contient la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Déclarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de SIAi par l'identifiant du type de document. Les subs seront ' automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xSIAi Dim gns_xSIAi As Notessession Dim gndb_xSIAi As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_xSIAi As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_xSIAi As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomItemCle_xSIAi = "SIAi_Nom" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVue_xSIAi = "V_SIAi20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xndSIAi(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call Initialisation_xSIAi
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCle_xSIAi, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSIAi, gc_NomVue_xSIAi, gnv_xSIAi, gnd_xSIAi)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xndSIAi = gnd_xSIAi End Function

Function xVarSIAi(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xndSIAi(p_Cle, p_Cache) xVarSIAi = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function
Sub Initialisation_xSIAi ' Initialisation des variables globales If gns_xSIAi Is Nothing Then Set gns_xSIAi = New Notessession Set gndb_xSIAi = gns_xSIAi.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Sub Queryopendocument(Source As Notesuiview, Continue As Variant) Continue = False End Sub

Dim gns_FOrdi As NotesSession Dim gndb_FOrdi As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_FOrdi As NotesUIWorkspace Dim gnuid_FOrdi As NotesUIDocument Dim gnd_FOrdi As NotesDocument
Dim g_Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin_FOrdi As String
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_FOrdi = "SL" Const gc_Element_FOrdi = "F_Ordi"

Function FOrdi_QuerySave(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim a_Usages As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_MPA As String
Call FOrdi_Initialisations
FOrdi_QuerySave = False
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call pnuid_Source.Refresh On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Set nd = pnuid_Source.Document
' Si le mot de passe du serveur a changé, ajouter la valeur précédente au champ Ordi_MPA_Prec ' et ajouter la date courante au champ Ordi_MPA_Prec_DM ' et ajouter l'utilisateur courant au champ Ordi_MPA_Prec_UM v_MPA = xVar(nd, "Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin", "") If g_Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin_FOrdi <> "" And v_MPA <> g_Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin_FOrdi Then Call SIIx_AppendVar(nd, "Ordi_MPA_Prec", g_Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin_FOrdi, True) Call SIIx_AppendVar(nd, "Ordi_MPA_Prec_DM", Now, True) Call SIIx_AppendVar(nd, "Ordi_MPA_Prec_UM", gns_FOrdi.UserName, True)
g_Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin_FOrdi = v_MPA End If
FOrdi_QuerySave = True Exit Function
FinSub: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FOrdi, gc_Element_FOrdi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FOrdi_Initialisations On Error Goto GererErreur
If gns_FOrdi Is Nothing Then Set gns_FOrdi = New Notessession Set gndb_FOrdi = gns_FOrdi.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_FOrdi = New Notesuiworkspace Set gnuid_FOrdi = gnuiws_FOrdi.CurrentDocument Set gnd_FOrdi = gnuid_FOrdi.Document
End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FOrdi, gc_Element_FOrdi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FOrdi_PostOpen(p_Source As NotesUIDocument) '=========================================================== ' Postopen du formulaire du serveur. '=========================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations '------------------- Call FOrdi_Initialisations
g_Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin_FOrdi = xVar(p_Source.Document, "Ordi_MotDePasseAdmin", "")
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FOrdi, gc_Element_FOrdi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_Insertions" Use "x_GDK"

' Déclarations globales Dim gns_VServ As NotesSession Dim gndb_VServ As NotesDatabase Dim gnuiws_VServ As NotesUIWorkspace
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VServ = "SL" Const gc_Element_VServ = "V_Serv"

Sub VServ_acModifMDPServHebergesMerlin '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Ce script change le mot de passe de tous les serveurs Merlin hébergés (et LogMeIn) ' note: le bouton d'action s'affiche si UserRole = (Serveur et LogMeIn) ou Admin '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_LgMI As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nv_LgMI20 As NotesView
Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_MotDePasse As String Dim v_NbMaj As Integer Dim v_NbLus As Integer
' Initialisations Call VServ_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_VServ, gc_Element_VServ) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Début", 0, 0, True) Set nv_LgMI20 = gndb_VServ.GetView("V_LgMI20") Call nv_LgMI20.Refresh
' Demander le nouveau mot de passe v_MotDePasse = gnuiws_VServ.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELEDIT, "Changement de mot de passe", _ "Veuillez saisir le nouveau mot de passe qui sera appliqué à tous les seveurs Merlin hébergés.") If v_MotDePasse = "" Then Print "Opération annulée" Exit Sub Elseif Instr(v_MotDePasse, " ") Then Messagebox "Le nouveau mot de passe ne doit pas contenir d'espace.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
v_Formule = {Form = "F_Serv" & @Contains(@Implode(Serv_Usages; ";"); "ML") & Serv_TypeInstallation = "1"} Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Formule : " & v_Formule, 0, 0, False)
Set ndc = gndb_VServ.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0) If ndc.Count = 0 Then Messagebox "Aucun serveur trouvé.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
' Boucler sur tous les serveurs Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
If SIIx_MajItem(nd, "Serv_MotDePasseAdmin", v_MotDePasse, False) Then ' Extraire le document LogMeIn du client Set nd_LgMI = nv_LgMI20.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "")) If Not nd_LgMI Is Nothing Then ' Mettre le nouveau mot de passe If SIIx_MajItem(nd_LgMI, "LgMI_MotPasse", v_MotDePasse, False) Then Call nd_LgMI.save(True, True) End If End If
Call nd.save(True, True) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Call SIGE_AjouterLog(xVar(nd, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") & " " & xVar(nd, "Conf_ClientNom1", ""), 0, 0, False) End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin - " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VServ, gc_Element_VServ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Erreur - " & Getthreadinfo(1) & " - " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus), -1, 0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VServ_Initialisations
If gns_VServ Is Nothing Then Set gns_VServ = New NotesSession Set gndb_VServ = gns_VServ.CurrentDatabase Set gnuiws_VServ = New NotesUIWorkspace End If
End Sub
