Function SILSXLC_OuvrirConnexion(Byval p_TypeConnection As String, Byval p_NomServeur As String, _ Byval p_NomUsager As String, Byval p_MotPasse As String, p_NoJournal As Boolean) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ouvrir la connexion avec le serveur ' Type de connection : db2, odbc2 On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSXLC_OuvrirConnexion = False
' Fermer la connexion précédente Call SILSXLC_FermerConnexion
If g_Debug_SILSXLC = False Then Set gls_SILSXLC = New LCSession Set glcc_SILSXLC = New LCConnection(p_TypeConnection) Select Case p_TypeConnection Case "db2": glcc_SILSXLC.Database = p_NomServeur Case Else: glcc_SILSXLC.Server = p_NomServeur End Select glcc_SILSXLC.UserID = p_NomUsager glcc_SILSXLC.Password = p_MotPasse
If p_NoJournal Then Call glcc_SILSXLC.SetPropertyBoolean(4,True) End If
' Ouvrir la connection glcc_SILSXLC.Connect Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog(|* SQL * SILSXLC_OuvrirConnexion - | & p_NomServeur, 0, 0, True) ' * DEBUG * End If g_ConnexionOuverte_SILSXLC = True SILSXLC_OuvrirConnexion = True Exit Function
GererErreur: If gls_SILSXLC.Status <> LCSUCCESS Then Print gls_SILSXLC.GetStatusText End If Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), "S: " & p_NomServeur & " - TC: " & p_TypeConnection , False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_OuvrirFichier(Byval p_NomTable As String, Byval p_SQLWhere As String, Byval p_SQLOrderBy As String, _ p_NbEnregistrements As Long) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ouvrir un fichier sur le serveur On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_SQLSelect As String
SILSXLC_OuvrirFichier = False If g_ConnexionOuverte_SILSXLC = False Then Exit Function End If
Set glcfl_SILSXLC = New LCFieldList v_SQLSelect = "SELECT * FROM " + p_NomTable If Len(p_SQLWhere) > 0 Then v_SQLSelect = v_SQLSelect + " WHERE " + p_SQLWhere End If If Len(p_SQLOrderBy) > 0 Then v_SQLSelect = v_SQLSelect + " ORDER BY " + p_SQLOrderBy End If
SILSXLC_OuvrirFichier = SILSXLC_ExecuterSQL(v_SQLSelect, p_NbEnregistrements) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), v_SQLSelect, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_DernierJourDuMois(p_Annee As Integer, p_Mois As Integer) As Integer On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSXLC_DernierJourDuMois = 0
' Premier jour du mois suivant Dim v_Jour As New NotesDateTime("") v_Jour.LSLocalTime = Datenumber(p_Annee, p_Mois, 1) Call v_Jour.SetAnyTime Call v_Jour.AdjustMonth(1)
' Dernière journée du mois Call v_Jour.AdjustDay(-1) SILSXLC_DernierJourDuMois = Day(v_Jour.LSLocalTime) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_ExtraireDate(Byval p_NomZone As String, Byval p_FormatDate As String) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une zone de l'enregistrement courant sous forme de date On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As String Dim v_Annee As Integer Dim v_Mois As Integer Dim v_Jour As Integer
If p_FormatDate = "CYMD" Then v_Date = Right("00000000" + SILSXLC_ExtraireString(p_NomZone), 8) v_Annee = Cint(Left(v_Date, 4)) v_Mois = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 5, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) Else v_Date = Right("000000" + SILSXLC_ExtraireString(p_NomZone), 6) Select Case p_FormatDate Case "DMY" : v_Annee = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) v_Mois = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) Case "MDY" : v_Annee = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) v_Mois = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) Case "YMD" : v_Annee = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) v_Mois = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) Case Else : v_Mois = 0 End Select End If
If v_Annee = 0 Or v_Mois < 1 Or v_Mois > 12 _ Or (v_Annee = 0 And v_Mois = 0 And v_Jour = 0) Then ' Mois invalide, retourner NULL SILSXLC_ExtraireDate = "" Else If v_Jour < 1 Or v_Jour > SILSXLC_DernierJourDuMois(v_Annee, v_Mois) Then ' Jour invalide, retourner NULL SILSXLC_ExtraireDate = "" Else SILSXLC_ExtraireDate = Datenumber(v_Annee, v_Mois, v_Jour) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomZone, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_AjouterEnregistrement(Byval p_NomTable As String, p_Colonnes As Variant, _ p_Valeurs As Variant, p_NbEnregistrements As Long) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ajouter un enregistrement dans un fichier On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_SQLInsert As String Dim v_Colonnes As String Dim v_Valeurs As String Dim i As Integer
SILSXLC_AjouterEnregistrement = False If g_ConnexionOuverte_SILSXLC = False Then Exit Function End If
If Isarray(p_Colonnes) <> Isarray(p_Valeurs) Then Exit Function End If If Isarray(p_Colonnes) Then If Ubound(p_Colonnes) <> Ubound(p_Valeurs) Then Exit Function End If v_Colonnes = Implode(p_Colonnes, ",")
For i = Lbound(p_Valeurs) To Ubound(p_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs <> "" Then v_Valeurs = v_Valeurs & "," End If v_Valeurs = v_Valeurs & Cstr(p_Valeurs(i)) Next Else If p_Colonnes = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Colonnes = p_Colonnes v_Valeurs = p_Valeurs End If
Set glcfl_SILSXLC = New LCFieldList v_SQLInsert = "INSERT INTO " & p_NomTable & " (" & v_Colonnes & ") VALUES(" & v_Valeurs & ")"
SILSXLC_AjouterEnregistrement = SILSXLC_ExecuterSQL(v_SQLInsert, p_NbEnregistrements) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), v_SQLInsert, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_ExtraireString(Byval p_NomZone As String) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une zone de l'enregistrement courant sous forme de chaîne On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSXLC_ExtraireString = ""
Dim v_lcf As Variant Dim v_lcs As LCStream
Set v_lcf = glcfl_SILSXLC.Lookup(p_NomZone) Set v_lcs = v_lcf.GetStream(1, 0) SILSXLC_ExtraireString = v_lcs.text Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomZone, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur(p_NomChamp As String, p_Format As String, p_FormatDate As String) As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur ' Format du variant retourné D=Date, H=Heure
SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur = "" p_FormatDate = ""
Select Case Ucase(p_Format) Case "D": ' Double = 0.00 SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireDouble(p_NomChamp) Case "L": ' Double = 0 SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireLong(p_NomChamp) Case "CYMD", "DMY", "MDY", "YMD": ' Date SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireDate(p_NomChamp, p_Format) p_FormatDate = "D" Case "HMS", "HM": ' Heure SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireTime(p_NomChamp, p_Format) p_FormatDate = "H" Case Else: ' String SILSXLC_ExtraireValeur = SILSXLC_ExtraireString(p_NomChamp) End Select Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSXLC_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomChamp, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_FermerConnexion As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet de fermer la connexion avec le serveur On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSXLC_FermerConnexion = False
If g_ConnexionOuverte_SILSXLC Then If g_Debug_SILSXLC = False Then glcc_SILSXLC.Disconnect Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog(|* SQL * SILSXLC_FermerConnexion|, 0, 0, True) ' * DEBUG * End If g_ConnexionOuverte_SILSXLC = False End If
SILSXLC_FermerConnexion = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_ExtraireDouble(Byval p_NomZone As String) As Double ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une zone de l'enregistrement courant sous forme de nombre (double) On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSXLC_ExtraireDouble = 0
Dim v_lcf As Variant Dim v_lcn As LCNumeric
Set v_lcf = glcfl_SILSXLC.Lookup(p_NomZone) Set v_lcn = v_lcf.GetNumeric(1) SILSXLC_ExtraireDouble = v_lcn.value Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomZone, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_ExecuterProgramme(Byval p_Programme As String, p_Parametres As Variant, _ p_Resultat As Variant) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ouvrir la connexion avec le serveur ' Type de connection : db2, odbc2 On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim lcfl_Entree As New LCFieldList Dim lcfl_Sortie As New LCFieldList Dim lcf As LCField Dim v_Resultat As Variant
SILSXLC_ExecuterProgramme = False If g_ConnexionOuverte_SILSXLC = False Then Exit Function End If
glcc_SILSXLC.Procedure = p_Programme
If Isarray(p_Parametres) Then For i = Lbound(p_Parametres) To Ubound(p_Parametres) Set lcf = lcfl_Entree.Append ("spParm", LCTYPE_TEXT) lcf.text = p_Parametres(i) Next Else Set lcf = lcfl_Entree.Append ("P1", LCTYPE_TEXT) lcf.text = p_Parametres End If
' Appeler le programme If g_Debug_SILSXLC = False Then v_Resultat = glcc_SILSXLC.Call(lcfl_Entree, 1, lcfl_Sortie) If v_Resultat = 0 Then Print "No results were generated from the procedure call." Elseif v_Resultat = LCCOUNT_UNKNOWN Then Print "A result set was generated but the number of results is unknown." Else Print "The stored procedure returned " & Cstr(v_Resultat) & " records." End If Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog(|* SQL * SILSXLC_ExecuterProgramme - | & p_Programme, 0, 0, True) ' * DEBUG * End If SILSXLC_ExecuterProgramme = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), p_Programme, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSXLC_ExtraireTime(Byval p_NomZone As String, Byval p_FormatDate As String) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une zone de l'enregistrement courant sous forme de date On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As String Dim v_Heure As Integer Dim v_Minutes As Integer Dim v_Secondes As Integer
If p_FormatDate = "HM" Then v_Date = Right("0000" + SILSXLC_ExtraireString(p_NomZone), 8) v_Heure = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) v_Minutes = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) v_Secondes = 0 Else v_Date = Right("000000" + SILSXLC_ExtraireString(p_NomZone), 6) V_Heure = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) v_Minutes = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) v_Secondes = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) End If
If v_Heure > 23 Or v_Minutes > 59 Or v_Secondes > 59 Then ' Mois invalide, retourner NULL SILSXLC_ExtraireTime = "" Else SILSXLC_ExtraireTime = Timenumber(v_Heure, v_Minutes, v_Secondes) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSXLC, gc_Element_SILSXLC, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomZone, False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINF = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINF = "SI_NotesFormula"
' Based on « Validating a Notes formula from LotusScript » submitted to the ' SearchDomino.com tip exchange by member Christian Cloutier
Const NULLHANDLE = 0 Const NO_ERROR = 0 Const ERR_FORMULA_COMPILATION = &h500 + 1
Declare Function NSFFormulaCompile Lib "nnotes.dll" ( _ ByVal FormulaName As Long, _ ByVal FormulaNameLength As Integer, _ ByVal FormulaText As LMBCS String, _ ByVal FormulaTextLength As Integer, _ rethFormula As Long, _ retFormulaLength As Integer, _ retCompileError As Integer, _ retCompileErrorLine As Integer, _ retCompileErrorColumn As Integer, _ retCompileErrorOffset As Integer, _ retCompileErrorLength As Integer _ ) As Integer
Declare Sub OSMemFree Lib "nnotes.dll"(ByVal hHandle As Long)
Declare Function OSLoadString Lib "nnotes.dll" ( _ ByVal hmodule As Long, _ ByVal status As Integer, _ ByVal s As String, _ ByVal slen As Integer _ ) As Integer

Sub Terminate
End Sub

Function SINF_ValiderFormule(p_Formule As String, p_Erreur As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' SINF_ValiderFormule - This function uses the Lotus C API To Return a Notes error's Text message. ' ' Return Value: True if formula is valid, False in an error was found ' p_Erreur - The text associated With the Notes API Error code, including the error offset. ' ================================================================================ Dim a_Resultat As Variant
SINF_ValiderFormule = False
a_Resultat = SINF_CheckFormulaValid(p_Formule) If a_Resultat(0) = NO_ERROR Then SINF_ValiderFormule = True Else p_Erreur = SINF_GetAPIError(a_Resultat(0)) & " (POS=" & CStr(a_Resultat(1)) & ",LEN=" & CStr(a_Resultat(2)) & ")" End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINF_GetAPIError(p_ErrorCode As Integer) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' GetAPIError - This function uses the Lotus C API To Return a Notes error's Text message. ' ' Return Value: String - The text associated With the Notes API Error code. ' ================================================================================
Dim iRetVal As Integer Dim sError As String * 1024
SINF_GetAPIError = "Undefined formula error"
sError = String(1024, 0) iRetVal = OSLoadString(0&, p_ErrorCode, sError, 1023) If iRetval <> 0 Then SINF_GetAPIError = Left$(sError, iRetVal) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINF_Evaluate(p_Formule As String, pnd As NotesDocument) As Variant On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' SINF_Evaluate - This function checks to see if the formula is valid before executing it. ' ' Return Value: An array if the formula was executed without error ' or A string containing the error message if the formula was found to be invalid ' or False if an execution error occured. ' ================================================================================ Dim v_Erreur As String
SINF_Evaluate = False
If SINF_ValiderFormule(p_Formule, v_Erreur) Then If pnd Is nothing then SINF_Evaluate = Evaluate(p_Formule) else SINF_Evaluate = Evaluate(p_Formule, pnd) End if Else SINF_Evaluate = v_Erreur End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINF_CheckFormulaValid(p_Formula As String) As Variant On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' CheckFormulaValid - This Function uses the Lotus C API To check the syntax of a Notes formula. ' ' Return Value: Variant - A 3 elements array containing: ' Index 0 - The compilation error code Or NO_ERROR (0) If valid ' Index 1 - The compilation error offset In formula Or NO_ERROR If valid ' Index 2 - The compilation error length Or NO_ERROR If valid ' ' Note: The compilation error code at Index 0 can Then be passed To GetAPIError() To Get more info about the error. ' ================================================================================
Dim iError As Integer Dim hFormula As Long Dim wFormulaLen As Integer Dim iCompileError As Integer Dim iCompileErrorLine As Integer Dim iCompileErrorColumn As Integer Dim iCompileErrorOffset As Integer Dim iCompileErrorLength As Integer Dim iArray(2) As Integer
iArray(0) = NO_ERROR iArray(1) = NO_ERROR iArray(2) = NO_ERROR SINF_CheckFormulaValid = iArray
iError = NSFFormulaCompile(0, 0, _ p_Formula, _ Len(p_Formula), _ hFormula, _ wFormulaLen, _ iCompileError, _ iCompileErrorLine, _ iCompileErrorColumn, _ iCompileErrorOffset, _ iCompileErrorLength)
If hFormula <> NULLHANDLE Then Call OSMemFree(hFormula) End If
If iError = ERR_FORMULA_COMPILATION Then iArray(0) = iCompileError iArray(1) = iCompileErrorOffset iArray(2) = iCompileErrorLength SINF_CheckFormulaValid = iArray End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Dim gns_SLSM As NotesSession
' Liste des champs AUTHORS - initialisée dans le sub Initialisations Dim g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM As Variant
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SLSM = "SL" Const gc_Element_SLSM = "SL_SecuriteMasque"
' Instructions pour changer la liste des champs AUTHORS ' Dans le SL appelant: ' Call SLSM_Initialisations ' g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM = Evaluate(|"Liste":"des":"champs":"AUTHORS"|)

Function SLSM_PeutModifierDocument(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItemsAuteurs As Variant) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim a_NomItemsAuteurs As Variant Dim v_ContientChampAuteurs As Boolean Dim i As Integer Dim a_ValeurItem As Variant Dim a_AuteursAutorises As Variant Dim v_RolesPermis As string Dim a_Roles As Variant
SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = False Call SLSM_Initialisations v_ContientChampAuteurs = False
' Construire la liste des champs AUTHORS If IsArray(p_NomItemsAuteurs) Then a_NomItemsAuteurs = p_NomItemsAuteurs Else a_NomItemsAuteurs = Evaluate(|"| & p_NomItemsAuteurs & |"|) End If
If a_NomItemsAuteurs(LBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs)) = "" Then ' Pas de champs AUTHORS SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True Else For i = LBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) To UBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) If pnd.HasItem(a_NomItemsAuteurs(i)) Then v_ContientChampAuteurs = True Exit For End if Next
If v_ContientChampAuteurs = False Then SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True ' Le document ne contient pas de champs AUTHORS Else
' Construire la liste des auteurs autorisés (Ids et rôles) For i = LBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) To UBound(a_NomItemsAuteurs) a_ValeurItem = xVarArray(pnd, a_NomItemsAuteurs(i)) If IsArray(a_ValeurItem) Then If IsArray(a_AuteursAutorises) Then a_AuteursAutorises = ArrayAppend(a_AuteursAutorises, a_ValeurItem) Else a_AuteursAutorises = a_ValeurItem End If End If Next
' Vérifier si l'utilisateur fais partie des auteurs autorisés If IsArray(a_AuteursAutorises) then If Not IsNull(ArrayGetIndex(a_AuteursAutorises, gns_SLSM.UserName, 1)) Then ' Username SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True Else ' Rôles v_RolesPermis = |"| & Join(a_AuteursAutorises, |":"|) & |"| a_Roles = Evaluate(|!@IsNotMember(| & v_RolesPermis & |; @UserRoles)|) If a_Roles(0) = 1 Then SLSM_PeutModifierDocument = True End If End If End if End If End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSM, gc_Element_SLSM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SLSM_QueryModeChange(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_Continue As Variant) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_PlateformeSDS As Boolean
p_Continue = False
If pnuid_Source.EditMode Then p_Continue = True ElseIf SLSM_PeutModifierDocument(pnuid_Source.Document, g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM) Then p_Continue = True End If
If p_Continue = False Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 255, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSM, gc_Element_SLSM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SLSM_QueryOpen(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_Mode As Integer, p_Isnewdoc As Variant, p_Continue As Variant) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_PlateformeSDS As Boolean
p_Continue = False
If p_Mode <> 1 Or p_IsNewDoc Then p_Continue = True ElseIf SLSM_PeutModifierDocument(pnuid_Source.Document, g_NomItemsAuteurs_SLSM) Then p_Continue = True End If

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSI" ou "SDSI" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSI" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "BBBB" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSI As NotesDatabase Dim gnvTabl_xSDSI As NotesView Dim gndTabl_xSDSI As NotesDocument
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_Cale_xSDSI As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Cale_xSDSI As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Inst_xSDSI As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Inst_xSDSI As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Inte_xSDSI As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Inte_xSDSI As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Suiv_xSDSI As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Suiv_xSDSI As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSI = "SDS Installations" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleCale_xSDSI = "Cale_NoCalendrier" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCale_xSDSI = "V_Cale20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleInst_xSDSI = "Inst_NoInstallation" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueInst_xSDSI = "V_Inst20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleInte_xSDSI = "Inte_NoIntervention" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueInte_xSDSI = "V_Inte20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleSuiv_xSDSI = "Suiv_NoInstallation" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSuiv_xSDSI = "V_Suiv20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSDSI_xIcnTabl(ByVal p_Cle As String, ByVal p_Table As String, ByVal p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSI_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSDSI_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSDSI_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If IsArray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = LBound(v_Valeurs) To UBound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If IsArray(v_Icones) Then If i >= LBound(v_Icones) And i <= UBound(v_Icones) Then xSDSI_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If IsArray(v_Icones) Then xSDSI_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSI_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function
Sub xSDSI_Initialisation ' Initialisation des variables globales If gndb_xSDSI Is Nothing Then Set gndb_xSDSI = xGDK_xndbNDB(gc_NomBD_xSDSI) End If End Sub

Function xSDSI_xVarInst(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSI_xVarInst = xVar(xSDSI_xndInst(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSI_xVarSuiv(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSI_xVarSuiv = xVar(xSDSI_xndSuiv(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSI_xVarCale(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSI_xVarCale = xVar(xSDSI_xndCale(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSI_xndTabl(ByVal pCle As Variant, ByVal pCache As Integer) As NotesDocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSI_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSDSI, "V_Tabl20", gnvTabl_xSDSI, gndTabl_xSDSI) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSI_xndTabl = gndTabl_xSDSI End Function

Function xSDSI_xndCale(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSI_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleCale_xSDSI, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSDSI, gc_NomVueCale_xSDSI, gnv_Cale_xSDSI, gnd_Cale_xSDSI)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSI_xndCale = gnd_Cale_xSDSI End Function

Function xSDSI_xndInte(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSI_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleInte_xSDSI, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSDSI, gc_NomVueInte_xSDSI, gnv_Inte_xSDSI, gnd_Inte_xSDSI)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSI_xndInte = gnd_Inte_xSDSI End Function

Function xSDSI_xDescTabl(ByVal p_Cle As String, ByVal p_Table As String, ByVal p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSI_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSI_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSI_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If IsArray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = LBound(v_Valeurs) To UBound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If IsArray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= LBound(v_Descriptions) And i <= UBound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSI_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If IsArray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSI_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSI_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSI_xVarTabl(ByVal pCle As Variant, ByVal pNomVar As String, ByVal pValeurNulle As Variant, _ ByVal pCache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document de type F_Tabl.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xndYYY) xSDSI_xVarTabl = xVar(xSDSI_xndTabl(pCle, pCache), pNomVar, pValeurNulle) ' Paramètres: 1 Notesdocument. Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le document ' recherché. ** Ne pas modifier ** End Function

Function xSDSI_xndSuiv(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSI_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleSuiv_xSDSI, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSDSI, gc_NomVueSuiv_xSDSI, gnv_Suiv_xSDSI, gnd_Suiv_xSDSI)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSI_xndSuiv = gnd_Suiv_xSDSI End Function

Function xSDSI_xVarInte(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSI_xVarInte = xVar(xSDSI_xndInte(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSI_xndInst(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSI_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleInst_xSDSI, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSDSI, gc_NomVueInst_xSDSI, gnv_Inst_xSDSI, gnd_Inst_xSDSI)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSI_xndInst = gnd_Inst_xSDSI End Function

agent.name: Mises à jour des postes de travail

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SICf"

Dim gns_A As Notessession Dim gndb_A As Notesdatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_InPC" ' Inscrire l'alias de l'agent

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_EnregistrerLog As Boolean
Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations
' Traitement Call A_MajPostes
If v_EnregistrerLog Then Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Sub A_MajPostes On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Integer
Set ndc = gndb_A.CreateDocumentCollection
Set nv = gndb_A.GetView("V_InPC20") If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Sub End If
' Charger les documents à traiter dans une collection Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
Call ndc.AddDocument(nd) Loop
' Maj les postes de travail Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Maj = A_MajPoste(nd) If v_Maj < 0 Then Call ndc.Deletedocument(nd) End If Loop
' Supprimer les documents InPC Call ndc.Removeall(True) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function A_MajPoste(pnd As NotesDocument) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_NomPoste As String Dim nd_Post As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim s As String
A_MajPoste = 0
v_Date = xVar(pnd, "Date", pnd.Created) If Today - v_Date <= 30 Then v_NomPoste = xVar(pnd, "NomPoste", "") Set nd_Post = xSICf_xndPost(v_NomPoste, True) If nd_Post Is Nothing Then Set nd_Post = New NotesDocument(gndb_xSICf) nd_Post.Form = "F_Post" nd_Post.Conf_Type = "Poste" Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_Post, "Auteurs", "[Admin]", AUTHORS) Call ni.AppendToTextList("[Poste]") nd_Post.Cle = v_NomPoste nd_Post.Description = "" nd_Post.Origine = "SDSP3" nd_Post.Conf_Icone = ""
nd_Post.Post_NomPoste = v_NomPoste End If
If Int(v_Date) <> Int(xVar(nd_Post, "Post_DateMaj", Today - 10)) Then nd_Post.Post_NomPoste = v_NomPoste nd_Post.Post_Domaine = xVarElem(pnd, "PosteDeTravail", 0, "") nd_Post.Post_PCManufacturier = xVarElem(pnd, "PosteDeTravail", 1, "") nd_Post.Post_PCModele = xVarElem(pnd, "PosteDeTravail", 2, "") s = xVarElem(pnd, "PosteDeTravail", 4, "0") If IsNumeric(s) Then nd_Post.Post_PCNbProcesseurs = CInt(s) Else nd_Post.Post_PCNbProcesseurs = "" End If s = xVarElem(pnd, "PosteDeTravail", 4, "0") If IsNumeric(s) Then nd_Post.Post_PCMemoireVive = CDbl(s) Else nd_Post.Post_PCMemoireVive = "" End If s = xVarElem(pnd, "PosteDeTravail", 6, "") If InStr(s, "\") > 0 Then nd_Post.Post_DernierUtilisateur = StrRightBack(s, "\") Else nd_Post.Post_DernierUtilisateur = s End If
nd_Post.Post_OSVersion = xVarElem(pnd, "SystemeExploitation", 0, "") nd_Post.Post_OSDescription = Replace(xVarElem(pnd, "SystemeExploitation", 1, ""), Chr(160), " ") nd_Post.Post_OSNoSerie = xVarElem(pnd, "SystemeExploitation", 2, "") nd_Post.Post_OSServicePack = xVarElem(pnd, "SystemeExploitation", 3, "") & "." & xVarElem(pnd, "SystemeExploitation", 4, "") s = xVarElem(pnd, "SystemeExploitation", 4, "0") If IsNumeric(s) Then nd_Post.Post_OSMemoireVive = CDbl(s) Else nd_Post.Post_OSMemoireVive = "" End If
nd_Post.Post_ReseauAdresseIp = Split(xVarElem(pnd, "Reseau", 0, ""), ":") nd_Post.Post_ReseauPasserelle = Split(xVarElem(pnd, "Reseau", 1, ""), ":") nd_Post.Post_ReseauDNS = Split(xVarElem(pnd, "Reseau", 2, ""), ":")
nd_Post.Post_AVEngin = Split(xVarElem(pnd, "Antivirus", 0, ""), ":") nd_Post.Post_AVVersion = Split(xVarElem(pnd, "Antivirus", 1, ""), ":") nd_Post.Post_AVServeur = Split(xVarElem(pnd, "Antivirus", 2, ""), ":")
s = xVar(pnd, "NotesVersion", "") If InStr(s, "|") > 0 Then nd_Post.Post_NotesVersion = StrLeft(xVar(pnd, "NotesVersion", ""), "|") Else nd_Post.Post_NotesVersion = xVar(pnd, "NotesVersion", "") End If nd_Post.Post_NotesBuild = xVar(pnd, "NotesBuildVersion", "") nd_Post.Post_NotesPlateforme = xVar(pnd, "Platform", "") nd_Post.Post_NotesUser = xVar(pnd, "UserName", "")
nd_Post.Post_DateSep = xVar(pnd, "DateSep", "") nd_Post.Post_IsDateDMY = xVar(pnd, "IsDateDMY", "") nd_Post.Post_IsDateMDY = xVar(pnd, "IsDateMDY", "") nd_Post.Post_IsDateYMD = xVar(pnd, "IsDateYMD", "") nd_Post.Post_TimeSep = xVar(pnd, "TimeSep", "") nd_Post.Post_TimeZone = xVar(pnd, "TimeZone", "") nd_Post.Post_DecimalSep = xVar(pnd, "DecimalSep", "") nd_Post.Post_ThousandsSep = xVar(pnd, "ThousandsSep", "")
nd_Post.Post_DateMaj = v_Date Call nd_Post.Save(True, False)
A_MajPoste = 1 End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: A_MajPoste = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), v_NomPoste, False) Exit Function End Function

Dim gnsSFH As Notessession

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant) Dim v_Now As Variant
If gnsSFH Is Nothing Then Set gnsSFH = New Notessession End If v_Now = Now
' Mise à jour de l'historique If Source.Isnewdoc Then Source.Document.HistoDC = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUC = gnsSFH.UserName Source.Document.HistoDM = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUM = "" Else If Source.Document.HistoDC(0) = "" Then Source.Document.HistoDC = Source.Document.Created Source.Document.HistoUC = "" End If Source.Document.HistoDM = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUM = gnsSFH.UserName End If End Sub

' Mise à jour de l'historique If Source.Isnewdoc Then Source.Document.HistoDC = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUC = gnsSFH.UserName Source.Document.HistoDM = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUM = "" Else If Source.Document.HistoDC(0) = "" Then Source.Document.HistoDC = Source.Document.Created Source.Document.HistoUC = "" End If Source.Document.HistoDM = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUM = gnsSFH.UserName End If End Sub

Declare Function CreateFile Lib "kernel32.dll" Alias "CreateFileA" (Byval lpFileName As String, Byval dwDesiredAccess As Long, Byval dwShareMode As Long, lpSecurityAttributes As Any, Byval dwCreationDisposition As Long, Byval dwFlagsAndAttributes As Long, Byval hTemplateFile As Long) As Long Declare Function CloseHandle Lib "kernel32.dll" (Byval hObject As Long) As Long

Function SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_NomFichier As String) As String ' RQ51336 PBE ' Retourne un nom de fichier unique en ajoutent "(n)" au nom du fichier au besoin ' Fichier ABC.PDF --> Fichier ABC (2).pdf ' p_NomFichier : Le nom du fichier doit inclure le chemin d'accès On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Continuer As Boolean Dim v_Dossier As String Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_Suffixe As String Dim i As integer Dim v_NomFichierUnique As String Dim s As string
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = p_NomFichier v_Continuer = False
If p_NomFichier <> "" Then If InStr(p_NomFichier, "\") > 0 Then s = Dir$(p_NomFichier, 0) If s <> "" Then v_Continuer = True End If End If End If
If v_Continuer then v_Dossier = StrLeftBack(p_NomFichier, "\") & "\" v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(p_NomFichier, "\")
If InStr(v_NomFichier, ".") > 0 Then v_Suffixe = "." & StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, ".") v_NomFichier = StrLeftBack(v_NomFichier, ".") Else v_Suffixe = "" End If
i = 1 Do i = i + 1 v_NomFichierUnique = v_Dossier & v_NomFichier & " (" & CStr(i) & ")" & v_Suffixe s = Dir$(v_NomFichierUnique) Loop Until s = ""
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = v_NomFichierUnique End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomFichier, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_DateFichier(p_CheminFichier As String, p_TypeInfo As String) As Variant '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retourne les date de création, modif ou consutation d'un fichier windows. ' Paramètres : p_TypeInfo ---> Le type info fichier a retourner ( C = date création, M = date modification, A = date dern. accès) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 76 Goto FichierInexistant
Dim v_ValRetour As Long ' valeur de retour Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_Fichier As Long ' handle du fichier ouvert Dim v_DateCreation As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure de création Dim v_DateDernAcces As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure dernière consultation Dim v_DateModif As FILETIME ' varible pour date et heure de dernière modification Dim v_DateFichier As SYSTEMTIME ' variable pour manipuler l'heure et date de FILETIME
' Initialisations SLFWIN_DateFichier = ""
If Dir$(p_CheminFichier) = "" Then Goto FichierInexistant End If
v_Fichier = CreateFile(p_CheminFichier, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, Byval Clng(0), OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE, 0) If v_Fichier = -1 Then Exit Function End If
' Retourne heures...creation, dern-accès, and dern-modification. v_ValRetour = GetFileTime(v_Fichier, v_DateCreation, v_DateDernAcces, v_DateModif)
' Fermer la connection au fichier. v_ValRetour = CloseHandle(v_Fichier) If v_ValRetour = 0 Then Print "ERREUR - Le fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " n'a pas été fermé normalement. (" & Cstr(v_ValRetour) & ")" End If
' Convertir la zone pour l'heure et Convertir le format FILETIME en format SYSTEMTIME Select Case p_TypeInfo Case "C" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateCreation) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateFichier) Case "M" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateModif, v_DateModif) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateModif, v_DateFichier) Case "A" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateDernAcces) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateFichier) End Select
v_Date = Evaluate(| @Date(| & v_DateFichier.wYear & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMonth & |;| & v_DateFichier.wDay & _ |;| & v_DateFichier.wHour & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMinute & |;| & v_DateFichier.wSecond & |) |)
If Isarray(v_Date) Then SLFWIN_DateFichier = v_Date(0) End If Exit Function
FichierInexistant: Print "Fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " introuvable." Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String, p_CheminFichierDestination As String, p_Remplacer As Boolean) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de convertir un fichier en base 64. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_FichierTempOrigine As Boolean Dim v_CheminFichierOrigine As String Dim v_CheminFichierTempDestination As String Dim a_Commande(1) As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim i As integer Dim v_Resultat As Integer
' Initialisations SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = False
' Validation des paramètres If p_CheminFichierOrigine = "" Then Exit function End If If Dir$(p_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) = "" Then Exit function End If
v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierOrigine p_CheminFichierDestination = Replace(p_CheminFichierDestination, |’|, |-|)
v_FichierTempOrigine = False If InStr(v_CheminFichierOrigine, |’|) > 0 Then v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp1" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End If FileCopy p_CheminFichierOrigine, v_CheminFichierOrigine v_FichierTempOrigine = True End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then If p_Remplacer then Kill p_CheminFichierDestination Else p_CheminFichierDestination = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminFichierDestination) End if End If
' Suppression du fichier temporaire v_CheminFichierTempDestination = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp2" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
' ===== Encodage du fichier ===== ' certutil -encode [Origine] [Temporaire] && findstr /v /c:- [Temp] > [Destination] && del [Temp] %rem a_Commande(0) = |/c certutil -encode "| & p_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| a_Commande(1) = |/c findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| a_Commande(2) = |/c del "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| %end rem
a_Commande(0) = |certutil -encode "| & v_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |"| a_Commande(1) = |findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| v_Commande = |/c | & Implode(a_Commande, |&&|) v_Resultat = ShellExecute(0&, "open", "cmd", v_Commande, "", SW_HIDE) If v_Resultat < 32 Then Exit Function End If
' Attendre jusqu'à ce que le fichier encodé soit créé Do If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then Exit Do End If Sleep 1 i = i + 1 Loop Until i > 10 ' Maximum 10 secondes
' Supprimer les fichier temporaires On Error 75 Resume next If v_FichierTempOrigine Then If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End if End If If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichierOrigine & " --> " & p_CheminFichierDestination, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_LireFichierString(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim v_Texte As String
SLFWIN_LireFichierString = ""
v_NoFichier = FreeFile Open p_CheminFichierOrigine For Input As #v_NoFichier Do Until EOF(v_NoFichier) Line Input #v_NoFichier, s v_Texte = v_Texte & s Loop Close #v_NoFichier
SLFWIN_LireFichierString = v_Texte Exit Function

Function SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString(p_Data As String, p_CheminFichier As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur

Function SIND_AccesAuteur(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_AccessLevel As Integer Dim a_UserNamesList As Variant Dim a_Items As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem
Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Vérifier l'accès à la base de documents Set ndb = pnd.ParentDatabase v_AccessLevel = ndb.CurrentAccessLevel
If v_AccessLevel < ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = False Elseif v_AccessLevel > ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Else ' Vérifier l'accès au document a_UserNamesList = Evaluate("@Usernameslist") a_Items = pnd.Items For i = 0 To Ubound(a_Items) Set ni = a_Items(i) If ni.IsAuthors() Then For j = 0 To Ubound(a_UserNamesList) If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(ni.Values, a_UserNamesList(j))) Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Exit Function End If Next End If Next End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_ValeurItemEgale(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, ByVal p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean ' Vérifie si la valeur de l'item p_NomItem est égale à p_Valeur On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_ValeurDifferente As Boolean Dim a_ValeurOrig As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("")
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = False v_ValeurDifferente = False
' Extraire les valeurs actuelles a_ValeurOrig = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If p_Date Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Dates - retirer la portion heure For i = LBound(a_ValeurOrig) To UBound(a_ValeurOrig) ndt.LSLocalTime = a_ValeurOrig(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime a_ValeurOrig(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next End If
' Si la nouvelle veleur contient des dates, retirer la portion heure If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next ElseIf p_Valeur <> "" Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur = ndt.LSLocalTime End If End If
' Vérifier si la nouvelle valeur est différent de la valeur actuelle If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Les deux valeurs sont des tableaux If UBound(p_Valeur) <> UBound(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Else For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) If CStr(p_Valeur(i)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig(i)) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Exit For End If Next End If Else ' p_Valeur est un tableau mais pas a_ValeurOrig If UBound(p_Valeur) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur(0)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If End If ElseIf IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' a_ValeurOrig est un tableau mais pas p_Valeur If UBound(a_ValeurOrig) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(a_ValeurOrig(0)) <> CStr(p_Valeur) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Ni p_Valeur ni a_ValeurOrig n'est un tableau v_ValeurDifferente = True End If
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = Not v_ValeurDifferente Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_AddedToFile(pnd As NotesDocument) As String
Dim db As String Dim s As String Dim ns As Integer
With pnd.ParentDatabase db = String$(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, .Server, .FilePath, db End With
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen db$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
Dim hNT As Long Dim T(1) As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, Clng("&H" & pnd.NoteID), 0, hNT If Not hNT = 0 Then SINAPI_NSFNoteGetInfo hNT, 13, T(0) SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT s = Space(80) SINAPI_ConvertTIMEDATEToText 0, 0, T(0), s, 80, ns SIND_AddedToFile = Left$(s, ns) End If
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Function

Function SIND_DecrypterDocument(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 17 Goto ErreurEncrypt
SIND_DecrypterDocument = False
If pnd.HasItem("Encrypt") Then ' Décryptage des champs ' --------------------------------- Forall ni In pnd.items If ni.isencrypted Then ni.isencrypted = False End If End Forall
' Crypter le document avec une clé bidon ' ------------------------------------------------------ Dim temp As New NotesItem(pnd, "x_Decrypter", "Cryptage") temp.IsEncrypted=True Call pnd.encrypt Call pnd.save(True, False)
' Retirer les champs relatifs au cryptage ' ---------------------------------------------------- Call pnd.removeitem("$Seal") Call pnd.removeitem("$SealData") Call pnd.removeitem("SecretEncryptionKeys") Call pnd.removeitem("Encrypt")
' Retirer le champ temporaire ' --------------------------------------- Call pnd.removeItem("x_Decrypter") Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If
SIND_DecrypterDocument = True Exit Function
ErreurEncrypt: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(pnd.UniversalID), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAcces As String, p_NomItemCle As String) As Long '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Ce script extrait le.s fichier.s attaché.s d'un document et le.s place dans le chemin d'accès spécifié (p_CheminAcces). ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd : document qui contient un ou des fichiers attachés ' p_NomItemRT : nom du champ RichText à traiter ' p_CheminAcces : chemin incluant le nom du fichier à détacher; si p_CheminAcces est vide, le TEMP de l'OS est alors utilisé ' p_NomItemCle : clé du document; ce texte est ajouté à la fin du nom du fichier. Exemple: <NoCandidat>_<NomFichier> ' ' Exemple: Fichier "ABC.PDF" et p_NomItemCle = 12345; le fichier sera nommé "12345_ABC.PDF" et s'il y a plusieurs fichiers au même nom alors ' le deuxième deviendra "12345_ABC (2).PDF". ' ' Valeur retournée: ' 0 : pas de fichier attaché dans le document ' -1 : une erreur s'est produite ' nombre de fichiers attachés traités '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim a_NomFichierAttaches As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject
Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_LienArchive As String Dim v_NoDocument As String Dim v_Chemin As String Dim v_Format As String Dim s As String
Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call SIND_Initialisations SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = 0
a_NomFichierAttaches = Evaluate(|@AttachmentNames|, pnd) If a_NomFichierAttaches(0) = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les fichiers attachés du champ For i = 0 to UBound(a_NomFichierAttaches)
' Créer le dossier où sera placé le fichier If p_CheminAcces = "" Then On Error 75 Resume Next p_CheminAcces = Environ("Temp") & "\SIND" MkDir p_CheminAcces p_CheminAcces = p_CheminAcces & "\" Else s = Dir$(p_CheminAcces, 16) If s = "" Then MkDir p_CheminAcces End If End If
Set neo = pnd.Getattachment(a_NomFichierAttaches(i)) v_NomFichier = p_NomItemCle & "_" & neo.name v_Chemin = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminAcces & "\" & v_NomFichier) v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, "\")
' Extraire le fichier et le placer dans le chemin indiqué Call neo.ExtractFile(v_Chemin) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
Next
SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = v_NbMaj Exit Function
GererErreur: SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), v_NomFichier & " --> " & p_CheminAcces, False) Exit Function End Function

%REM Description: Converts a NotesDocument to an RTF-Document and saves it under the filePath Generates and removes some temporary Files while Working %END REM
Function SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAccesRTF As String) As boolean On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim v_CheminFichier_Body As String Dim v_CheminFichier_Fonts As String Dim v_CheminFichier_Temp As String Dim v_FileSize As Long
Dim i As Integer Dim f As Integer Dim fnew As Integer
SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF = False
Set nd_Temp = pnd.ParentDatabase.CreateDocument() Set nrti = nd_Temp.CreateRichTextItem("Body")
Call pnd.RenderToRTItem(nrti)
v_CheminFichier_Body = p_CheminAccesRTF & "_Body.cd" v_CheminFichier_Fonts = p_CheminAccesRTF & "_Fonts.cd" v_CheminFichier_Temp = p_CheminAccesRTF & ".cd"
Call SINAPI_MailGetMessageBodyComposite(nd_Temp.handle , "Body", v_CheminFichier_Body, v_FileSize) Call SINAPI_MailGetMessageBodyComposite(nd_Temp.handle , "$Fonts", v_CheminFichier_Fonts, v_FileSize)
' Concatener le body et les polices dans un seul fichier fnew = FreeFile Open v_CheminFichier_Temp For Binary As #fnew
' $fonts f = FreeFile Open v_CheminFichier_Fonts For Binary As #f Do Until EOF (f) Get #f,,i Put #fnew,, i Loop Close #f
' rich text Open v_CheminFichier_Body For Binary As #f ' skip 2 bytes Seek #f, 3 Do Until EOF (f) Get #f,,i Put #fnew,, i Loop Close ' Fin concatener
Call SINAPI_ExportRTF(v_CheminFichier_Temp, 0, 0, "", p_CheminAccesRTF)
SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF = True Kill v_CheminFichier_Body Kill v_CheminFichier_Fonts Kill v_CheminFichier_Temp
Exit Function

Function SIW_aTachesActives As Variant ' Détermine si un programme est actif sur l'ordinateur ' p_NomProgramme est le nom de l'objet ex.: notepad.exe On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 75 Resume Next
Dim v_CheminScript As String Dim v_CheminFichier As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim oShell As Variant Dim s As String Redim a(99) As String Dim l As Long
v_CheminScript = Environ("TEMP") & "\SIW" Mkdir v_CheminScript
v_CheminScript = v_CheminScript & "\" & xUnique("") & ".bat" Kill v_CheminScript
v_CheminFichier = Strleftback(v_CheminScript, ".") & ".log" Kill v_CheminFichier
' Construire le script v_Commande = |tasklist /NH /FO CSV > | & v_CheminFichier v_NoFichier = Freefile() Open v_CheminScript For Append As v_NoFichier Print #v_NoFichier, v_Commande Close v_NoFichier
' Exécuter le script Set oShell = CreateObject("Wscript.Shell") oShell.Run v_CheminScript, 1, True
' Lire le fichier résultat v_NoFichier = Freefile() On Error 101 Goto ErreurOpen Open v_CheminFichier For Input As v_NoFichier Do Until Eof(v_NoFichier) Line Input #v_NoFichier, s a(l) = s If l = Ubound(a) Then Redim Preserve a(l + 100) As String End If l = l + 1 Loop Close v_NoFichier If l > 0 Then Redim Preserve a(l) As String End If SIW_aTachesActives = a
ErreurOpen: ' Supprimer les fichiers temporaires Kill v_CheminScript Kill v_CheminFichier Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'Base64 1.4S:
Option Public Option Explicit
%REM This set of functions will allow you to encode and decode strings and files in Base64 format. The implementation is all in LotusScript, and requires no external DLLs or tricks. It was written and tested in R5, but it should be backwards compatible to at least 4.6
This is the 1.4 "release" of the functions, from December 28, 2002. The code was originally written by Julian Robichaux, and is maintained by him on the http://www.nsftools.com website.
Release History: 1.4 (Dec 28, 2002) -- fixed TrimBytesFromFile function to properly handle writing odd numbers of bytes to a new file (thanks to Peter Leugner at www.as-computer.de)
1.3 (Dec 26, 2002) -- Modified DecodeFile function to properly handle the line terminators that the Print statement adds -- Fixed GetFileChunk function to properly read the last byte in a file
1.2 (Dec 17, 2002) -- Added functions for encrypting and decrypting entire files
1.1 (Nov 5, 2002) -- Fixed typo/error in EncodeBase64 function
1.0 (Nov 1, 2002) -- Initial release %END REM
%REM '** examples of using the Base64 functions in this agent Dim eString As String, dString As String Dim isOkay As Integer
eString = "QUJDREVGRw==" '** ABCDEFG dString = SIB64_DecodeBase64(eString)
isOkay = SIB64_IsBase64(eString)
eString = SIB64_EncodeBase64("AbCdEfG" & Chr(0) & "123") eString = SIB64_BreakString(eString, 5) dString = SIB64_DecodeBase64(eString)
isOkay = SIB64_IsBase64(SIB64_RemoveWhitespace(eString)) isOkay = SIB64_IsBase64(dString)
isOkay = SIB64_EncodeFile("C:\Autoexec.bat", "C:\Autoexec.enc") isOkay = SIB64_DecodeFile("C:\Autoexec.enc", "C:\Autoexec.dec")
%END REM
'** the characters used to encode in Base64, in order of appearance Const b64chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

Function SIB64_DecodeBase64 (ByVal encText As String) As String '** This function will decode a Base64 string. It's probably a good '** idea to check the validity of the string with the IsBase64 function '** prior to processing it, to avoid strange errors. '** by Julian Robichaux -- http://www.nsftools.com On Error GoTo endOfFunction
Dim encNum As Long Dim decText As String Dim i As Integer
'** remove any line termination characters and whitespace first encText = SIB64_RemoveWhitespace(encText)
For i = 1 To Len(encText) Step 4 '** convert the next 2 of 4 characters to a number we can decode encNum = (InStr(b64chars, Mid$(encText, i, 1)) - 1) * (2 ^ 18) encNum = encNum Or ((InStr(b64chars, Mid$(encText, i+1, 1)) - 1) * (2 ^ 12))
'** deal with trailing '=' If (Mid$(encText, i+2, 1) = "=") Then decText = decText & Chr(Fix(encNum / (2 ^ 16)) And &HFF) ElseIf (Mid$(encText, i+3, 1) = "=") Then encNum = encNum Or ((InStr(b64chars, Mid$(encText, i+2, 1)) - 1) * (2 ^ 6)) decText = decText & Chr(Fix(encNum / (2 ^ 16)) And &HFF) decText = decText & Chr(Fix(encNum / (2 ^ 8)) And &HFF) Else encNum = encNum Or ((InStr(b64chars, Mid$(encText, i+2, 1)) - 1) * (2 ^ 6)) encNum = encNum Or (InStr(b64chars, Mid$(encText, i+3, 1)) - 1) decText = decText & Chr(Fix(encNum / (2 ^ 16)) And &HFF) decText = decText & Chr(Fix(encNum / (2 ^ 8)) And &HFF) decText = decText & Chr(encNum And &HFF) End If
Next
endOfFunction: SIB64_DecodeBase64 = decText Exit Function
End Function

Function SIB64_EncodeBase64 (decText As String) As String '** This function will Base64 encode a string. The string doesn't have to '** be text-only, either. You can also encode strings of non-ASCII data, '** like the contents of a binary file. If you're encoding a whole file, '** make sure you break the contents into lengths divisible by three, so '** you can concatenate them together properly. '** by Julian Robichaux -- http://www.nsftools.com On Error GoTo endOfFunction
Dim decNum As Long Dim encText As String Dim chunk As String Dim i As Integer
For i = 1 To Len(decText) Step 3 '** pad the 3-character string with Chr(0), if need be chunk = Left$(Mid$(decText, i, 3) & Chr(0) & Chr(0), 3)
'** get the number we'll use for encoding decNum = Asc(Mid$(chunk, 1, 1)) * (2 ^ 16) decNum = decNum Or Asc(Mid$(chunk, 2, 1)) * (2 ^ 8) decNum = decNum Or Asc(Mid$(chunk, 3, 1))
'** calculate the first 2 of 4 encoded characters encText = encText & Mid$(b64chars, (Fix(decNum / (2 ^ 18)) And &H3F) + 1, 1) encText = encText & Mid$(b64chars, (Fix(decNum / (2 ^ 12)) And &H3F) + 1, 1)
'** pad with '=' as necessary when we reach the end of the string Select Case ( Len(decText) - i ) Case 0 : encText = encText & "==" Case 1 : encText = encText & Mid$(b64chars, (Fix(decNum / (2 ^ 6)) And &H3F) + 1, 1) encText = encText & "=" Case Else : encText = encText & Mid$(b64chars, (Fix(decNum / (2 ^ 6)) And &H3F) + 1, 1) encText = encText & Mid$(b64chars, (decNum And &H3F) + 1, 1) End Select
Next
endOfFunction: SIB64_EncodeBase64 = encText Exit Function
End Function

Function SIB64_IsBase64 (someString As String) As Integer '** check to see if the string is a well-formed Base64 string Dim legalString As String Dim i As Integer
SIB64_IsBase64 = False legalString = b64chars & "="
'** check for bad string length (must be a multiple of 4) If (Len(someString) Mod 4 > 0) Then Exit Function End If
'** check for illegal characters For i = 1 To Len(someString) If (InStr(legalString, Mid$(someString, i, 1)) = 0) Then Exit Function End If Next
'** make sure any '=' are only at the end Select Case (InStr(someString, "=")) Case 0 : '** no equals signs is okay Case Is < (Len(someString) - 1) : Exit Function Case (Len(someString) - 1) : If (Right$(someString, 1) <> "=") Then Exit Function End If End Select
'** if we made it through all the conditions, then the string looks good SIB64_IsBase64 = True
End Function

Function SIB64_BreakString (Text As String, lineLength As Integer) As String '** add line terminators to a string at the given interval Dim newText As String Dim lineTerm As String Dim i As Integer
lineTerm = Chr(13) & Chr(10)
For i = 1 To Len(Text) Step lineLength newText = newText & Mid$(Text, i, lineLength) & lineTerm Next
newText = Left$(newText, Len(newText) - Len(lineTerm)) SIB64_BreakString = newText End Function

Function SIB64_RemoveWhitespace (ByVal Text As String) As String '** remove line terminators, spaces, and tabs from a string Call SIB64_ReplaceSubstring(Text, Chr(13), "") Call SIB64_ReplaceSubstring(Text, Chr(10), "") Call SIB64_ReplaceSubstring(Text, Chr(9), "") Call SIB64_ReplaceSubstring(Text, " ", "")
SIB64_RemoveWhitespace = Text End Function

Function SIB64_ReplaceSubstring (Text As String, find As String, p_Replace As String) Dim pos As Integer pos = InStr(Text, find)
Do While (pos > 0) Text = Left$(Text, pos - 1) & p_Replace & Mid$(Text, pos + Len(find)) pos = InStr(pos + Len(p_Replace), Text, find) Loop End Function

Function SIB64_EncodeFile (fileIn As String, fileOut As String) As Integer '** Base64 encode an entire file (fileIn) and write the output to '** another file (fileOut). We're writing the output to another file '** because there's a possibility that the output will be larger than '** 32,000 characters, which would overflow an output String. On Error GoTo processError
Dim fin As Integer, fout As Integer Dim finOpen As Integer, foutOpen As Integer Dim datain As String, dataout As String Dim worktext As String, leftover As String Const CHUNKSIZE = 15000
'** open the files for input/output (if there are any errors here, '** we'll exit in the processError section at the bottom) fin = FreeFile() Open fileIn For Input As fin finOpen = True fout = FreeFile Open fileOut For Output As fout foutOpen = True
'** start getting data from the input file, encoding it, and sending it '** to the output file datain = SIB64_GetFileChunk(fin, CHUNKSIZE) Do While (Len(datain) > 0) '** encode in groups of 57 characters, which will give us output '** in lines of 76 characters (fairly standard) leftover = leftover & datain While (Len(leftover) > 57) worktext = Left$(leftover, 57) leftover = Mid$(leftover, 58) dataout = SIB64_EncodeBase64(worktext) Print #fout, dataout Wend datain = SIB64_GetFileChunk(fin, CHUNKSIZE) Loop
'** encode anything we had left, and close the files If (Len(leftover) > 0) Then Print #fout, SIB64_EncodeBase64(leftover) End If
Close #fin, #fout SIB64_EncodeFile = True Exit Function
processError: If (finOpen) Then Close #fin If (foutOpen) Then Close #fout SIB64_EncodeFile = False Exit Function
End Function

Function SIB64_DecodeFile (fileIn As String, fileOut As String) As Integer '** Base64 decode an entire file (fileIn) and write the output to '** another file (fileOut). We're writing the output to another file '** because there's a possibility that the output will be larger than '** 32,000 characters, which would overflow an output String. On Error GoTo processError
Dim fin As Integer, fout As Integer Dim finOpen As Integer, foutOpen As Integer Dim datain As String, dataout As String Dim worktext As String, leftover As String Const CHUNKSIZE = 16000
'** figure out how long the line terminator character is Dim session As New NotesSession Dim lineTermLen As Integer If (InStr(session.Platform, "Windows") > 0) Then lineTermLen = 2 Else lineTermLen = 1 End If
'** open the files for input/output (if there are any errors here, '** we'll exit in the processError section at the bottom) fin = FreeFile() Open fileIn For Input As fin finOpen = True fout = FreeFile Open fileOut For Output As fout foutOpen = True
'** start getting data from the input file, encoding it, and sending it '** to the temporary output file datain = SIB64_GetFileChunk(fin, CHUNKSIZE) Do While (Len(datain) > 0) datain = SIB64_RemoveWhitespace(datain)
'** make sure we're decoding in groups of characters '** that are multiples of 4 leftover = leftover & datain worktext = Left$(leftover, Len(leftover) - (Len(leftover) Mod 4)) leftover = Right$(leftover, Len(leftover) Mod 4) dataout = SIB64_DecodeBase64(worktext) Print #fout, dataout '** adjust the cursor position so we overwrite the line terminator that's '** automatically been appended to the end of the line by Print Seek #fout, Seek(fout) - lineTermLen
datain = SIB64_GetFileChunk(fin, CHUNKSIZE) Loop
'** decode anything we had left, and close the files If (Len(leftover) > 0) Then Print #fout, leftover End If
Close #fin, #fout finOpen = False foutOpen = False
'** okay, so here's the problem: the Print statement automatically appends '** a line terminator to the end of all the lines it printed. We accounted for '** this while we were writing to the output file in the Do While loop, but '** there's going to be an extra line terminator at the end of the file that we '** couldn't do anything about. So we'll need to copy all but the last one or '** two bytes (depending on the length of the line terminator on this platform) '** from the temporary output file to the output file that the user wants using '** Get and Put commands. We couldn't use Put before because when Put '** writes a text string to a file, it always writes the Unicode version of the '** string, which isn't what we wanted (try it sometime and see how it looks...) '** The TrimBytesFromFile function will take care of the problem. Call SIB64_TrimBytesFromFile(fileOut, lineTermLen)
SIB64_DecodeFile = True Exit Function
processError: If (finOpen) Then Close #fin If (foutOpen) Then Close #fout SIB64_DecodeFile = False Exit Function
End Function

Function SIB64_GetFileChunk (fileNum As Integer, size As Integer) As String '** get the next chunk of text from a Random file, up to a given size On Error GoTo processError Dim dataLength As Long
dataLength = LOF(fileNum) - Seek(fileNum) + 1 Select Case (dataLength) Case Is <= 0 SIB64_GetFileChunk = "" Case Is > size SIB64_GetFileChunk = Input$(size, fileNum) Case Else SIB64_GetFileChunk = Input$(CInt(dataLength), fileNum) End Select
Exit Function
processError: SIB64_GetFileChunk = "" Exit Function
End Function

Function SIB64_TrimBytesFromFile (fileName As String, bytesToTrim As Integer) '** trim the specified number of bytes from the end of the specified '** file by copying the file contents to a temporary file using Get and '** Put, and then deleting the specified file and replacing it with '** the temporary file On Error GoTo processError
Dim tempFileName As String Dim fin As Integer, fout As Integer Dim finOpen As Integer, foutOpen As Integer Dim dataLength As Long Dim lineLength As Integer Dim data As String Dim dataInt As Integer Const CHUNKSIZE = 15000
tempFileName = fileName & ".tmp"
fin = FreeFile() Open fileName For Binary As fin finOpen = True fout = FreeFile() Open tempFileName For Binary As fout foutOpen = True
'** this works almost exactly like the GetFileChunk function, subtracting '** bytesToTrim when we reach the last "chunk" of the file dataLength = LOF(fin) - Seek(fin) + 1 - bytesToTrim Do While (dataLength > 1) If (dataLength > CHUNKSIZE) Then lineLength = CHUNKSIZE Else lineLength = CInt(dataLength) End If
'** a LotusScript string is actually 2 bytes per character, so we only '** want to get a string that's half the length of the number of bytes '** that we need data = Space$(Fix(lineLength / 2)) Get #fin, , data Put #fout, , data
dataLength = LOF(fin) - Seek(fin) + 1 - bytesToTrim Loop
'** if there's only one more byte to read, we need to back up one byte '** because there are no one-byte data types in LotusScript prior to R6, '** so we're always writing an even number of bytes at a time If (dataLength = 1) Then Seek #fin, Seek(fin) - 1 Seek #fout, Seek(fout) - 1 Get #fin, , dataInt Put #fout, , dataInt End If
Close #fin, #fout finOpen = False foutOpen = False
'** once all the files are closed, delete the original file and rename the '** temporary file so it becomes the original Kill fileName Name tempFileName As fileName Exit Function
processError: If (finOpen) Then Close #fin If (foutOpen) Then Close #fout Exit Function
End Function

Const gc_CompanyName_SICfSDS = "*SI Configurations" Const gc_MajUserSDST_SICfSDS = False ' Maj la base de documents Akufen
